transcript.content: Hello, I'm Dr. Smith. What brings you in today?

For the past ten months, I've had this overwhelming energy where I feel constantly on the go and just can't sit still. My mood has been bouncing all over the place, switching from feeling incredibly high and happy to getting extremely irritated at the smallest things. I just feel so restless and wired all the time.
During these periods of high energy and mood swings, have you ever experienced hallucinations or delusions, like hearing voices or having strong beliefs that others don’t share?

Yes, I definitely do, but it only seems to happen when I'm in these intense, high-energy states. Sometimes I hear voices whispering when no one is actually around, or I get this overwhelming feeling that I'm being watched and monitored by others. Outside of these wild periods, though, none of that happens.
Have you ever had hallucinations or delusions, like hearing voices or feeling watched, during times when you were not in a high-energy or mood episode?

No, I've never experienced anything like that when my mood is stable. Those voices and strange feelings only happen when I'm in one of my high-energy phases. When my mood goes back to normal, all of those things completely disappear.
